usedFor: Each chat lead captured by Asyntai AI Chatbot becomes a HubSpot contact.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Captured” in Asyntai AI Chatbot, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A captured lead raised a hand in chat, and is ready to assign and follow up.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs an email, so a chat that ends without one cannot become a contact.
